newsitem.title: USA: Revlon in China joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Revlon in China joint venture.

text.p: Revlon Inc., targeting the huge Chinese consumer market, said Tuesday it entered a joint venture with a Beijing company to manufacture and sell cosmetics in China.
Revlon said its Revlon Consumer Products Corp. agreed with Sumstar Group Corp., a Beijing-based investment firm, to manufacture, distribute and market Revlon products in China.
A Revlon spokeswoman said the company was not ready to reveal terms of the agreement.

"Our joint venture with Sumstar broadens our operations in Asia and reinforces Revlon's commitment to expansion in emerging markets," George Fellows, Revlon president and chief operating officer, said in a statement announcing the move.

Distribution of the company's products in major cities throughout China should begin in the first quarter of 1997, Revlon said. The cosmetics maker currently does only minimal business in China through other distributors.
The new venture's headquarters and manufacturing facilities will be located in Shanghai.
Revlon's stock gained 37.5 cents to $30.50 in early trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
